域名名称。<props="china">可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
description.en: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the domain name.

description.zh: 关键字，按照“%KeyWord%”模式搜索，不区分大小写。
description.en: The keyword for searches in "%KeyWord%" mode. The value is not case-sensitive.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
当前页数，起始值为**1**，默认为**1**。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值**100**，默认为**20**。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1 to 100**. Default value: **20**.
The start date of the query. Specify the start date in the **YYYY-MM-DD** format.
The IP address of the client.
The end date of the query. Specify the end date in the **YYYY-MM-DD** format.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-record-logs --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.1 --domain-name example.com --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --key-word test --start-date 2015-12-12 --end-date 2015-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeRecordLogs --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate '2015-12-12' --PageSize 20 --DomainName 'example.com' --PageNumber 1 --endDate '2015-12-12' --KeyWord test --UserClientIp '192.0.2.1' --Lang en
